new_items.name: Venus the Goddess

new_items.name: Janus

new_items.name: Bacchus

new_items.name: Freyja

new_items.summary: The Norse god Freyr is shown with a green harvest branch and a radiant sword.

new_items.name: Heimdall

new_items.name: Baldr

new_items.name: Niflheim

new_items.name: Hel

new_items.name: Frost Giant

new_items.name: Gungnir

new_items.name: Egyptian Mythology
new_items.summary: Gods of the Nile, sacred animals and tales of the afterlife shape Egyptian mythology.

new_items.name: Ancient Egypt
new_items.summary: The Nile valley's ancient temples, pyramids and fertile riverbanks form a vast kingdom.

new_items.name: Egyptian Pantheon
new_items.summary: The great Egyptian pantheon gathers animal-headed and solar gods of the Nile.

new_items.name: Ra
new_items.summary: The Egyptian sun god Ra wears a golden solar disk as a falcon and serpent stand guard.

new_items.name: Isis
new_items.summary: The Egyptian goddess Isis spreads protective feathered wings around a throne-shaped crown.

new_items.name: Osiris
new_items.summary: The Egyptian ruler of the afterlife holds a crook and flail beneath an ornate white crown.

new_items.name: Horus
new_items.summary: The falcon-headed Egyptian god Horus carries a royal crown and watchful golden eye.

new_items.name: Anubis
new_items.summary: The Egyptian jackal-headed god Anubis watches over embalming and the journey after death.

new_items.name: Bastet
new_items.summary: The Egyptian cat goddess Bastet bears upright feline ears and a ceremonial sistrum.

new_items.name: Thoth
new_items.summary: The ibis-headed Egyptian god Thoth guards writing, measurement and ancient knowledge.

new_items.name: Set of Egypt
new_items.summary: The Egyptian god Set carries a forked desert staff and the tall ears of his sacred animal.

new_items.name: Hathor
new_items.summary: The Egyptian goddess Hathor wears a sun disk between curved cow horns.

new_items.name: Sekhmet
new_items.summary: The Egyptian lioness goddess Sekhmet wears a solar crown and fierce feline muzzle.

new_items.name: Sobek

new_items.name: Nephthys

new_items.name: Ammit

new_items.name: Apophis
new_items.summary: The Egyptian chaos serpent Apophis coils against the nightly solar voyage of Ra.

new_items.name: Eye of Horus
new_items.summary: The protective Eye of Horus is drawn as a stylized Egyptian symbol of healing and wholeness.

new_items.summary: A layered stone timeline orders the vast eras recorded by fossils in sedimentary rock.

new_items.name: Paleozoic Era
new_items.summary: The Paleozoic is pictured through an ancient seafloor and a primitive shelled arthropod.

new_items.name: Cenozoic Era
new_items.summary: The Cenozoic era is represented by flowering hills and the rise of large mammals.

new_items.name: Triassic Period
new_items.summary: The Triassic period shows the first dinosaurs among sparse conifers on dry red plains.

new_items.name: Late Cretaceous
new_items.summary: A late Cretaceous landscape brings flowering plants and great horned dinosaurs together.

new_items.name: Pleistocene Epoch
new_items.summary: Ice-age grasslands and large mammals characterize the late Pleistocene epoch.

new_items.name: Ice Age
new_items.summary: The Ice Age blankets prehistoric valleys with glaciers and wind-carved snowfall.

new_items.name: Cambrian Period
new_items.summary: Cambrian oceans teem with unfamiliar early animal forms and seafloor burrows.

new_items.name: Carboniferous Period
new_items.summary: The Carboniferous supports giant swamp forests, fern-like trees and ancient insects.

new_items.name: Prehistoric Ocean
new_items.summary: Ancient oceans shelter extinct sea reptiles and fish across several geological eras.

new_items.name: Theropod
new_items.summary: Theropods are mostly two-legged dinosaurs with grasping claws and predatory jaws.

new_items.name: Sauropod
new_items.summary: Sauropods are giant long-necked plant-eating dinosaurs with column-like legs.

new_items.name: Ceratopsian
new_items.summary: Ceratopsians are beaked dinosaurs with skull frills and distinctive facial horns.

new_items.name: Hadrosaur
new_items.summary: Hadrosaurs are duck-billed herbivores whose heads often bear hollow bone crests.

new_items.name: Feathered Dinosaur
new_items.summary: Feathered dinosaurs display a transition from predatory scales to insulating plumage.

new_items.name: Pterosaur
new_items.summary: Pterosaurs were flying reptiles whose extended finger bones supported membrane wings.

new_items.name: Marine Reptile
new_items.summary: Marine reptiles evolved flippers and streamlined bodies to hunt in ancient seas.

new_items.name: Prehistoric Mammal
new_items.summary: The age of mammals is marked by fur-covered bodies and diversified land habitats.

new_items.name: Fossilized Dinosaur Egg
new_items.summary: A large speckled dinosaur egg rests in a ring of broken shell fragments.

new_items.name: Fossil Footprint

new_items.name: Compsognathus

new_items.name: Suchomimus

new_items.name: Albertosaurus

new_items.name: Ornithomimus

new_items.name: Brachiosaurus

new_items.name: Apatosaurus

new_items.name: Argentinosaurus

new_items.name: Dreadnoughtus

new_items.name: Camarasaurus

new_items.name: Saltasaurus
